snippet.title: Hand of Hexes demo release trailer
snippet.description:
Play cards to cast spells that control enemy hordes and use your deck to build deadly mazes of towers with funky attack patterns. 
Play the demo now at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238220/Hand_of_Hexes/ 

Credits for the trailer music go to bermrad. Check out his awesome game, Trials of Valor on steam too!
